author: Red Canary (converted by X3M.AI)
prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on target machine

capabilities: Provides 2 focused Red Canary Atomic Red Team tests covering 2 MITRE ATT&CK techniques for Reconnaissance.
Exercises external information-gathering and active scanning detections using small, independently selectable atomic tests.
Includes one-step Chains for individual atomics and a full-tactic convenience Chain when multiple tests are available.
use_cases: Validate endpoint, identity, network, and SIEM detections mapped to ATT&CK Reconnaissance.
Verify that preventive controls block expected behavior and that telemetry reaches defensive tooling.
Select individual atomics to close specific ATT&CK coverage gaps during an authorized Purple Team exercise.
safety_notes: Operational impact varies by atomic test; inspect each command, input, prerequisite, and cleanup action before execution.
Full-tactic convenience Chains run many independent tests sequentially and are not a validated adversary campaign.
Run only on explicitly authorized targets and verify cleanup results after each test.

scripts.name: ART - T1592.001 - Enumerate PlugNPlay Camera
scripts.description: Enumerate PlugNPlay Camera using powershell commandlet. this technique was seen in dcrat malware backdoor capabilities where it enumerate the camera info mounted on the compromised host. reference: https://www.mandiant.com/resources/analyzing-dark-crystal-rat-backdoor
scripts.command: Get-CimInstance -Query "SELECT * FROM Win32_PnPEntity WHERE (PNPClass = 'Image' OR PNPClass = 'Camera')"
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1595.003 - Web Server Wordlist Scan
scripts.name: ART - T1595.003 - Web Server Wordlist Scan
scripts.description: This test will scan a target system with a wordlist of common directories and file paths.

Import-Module "PathToAtomicsFolder/T1595.003/src/WebServerScan.ps1"
Invoke-WordlistScan -Target "#{art_recon_1595_003_target}" -Wordlist "#{art_recon_1595_003_wordlist}" -Timeout "#{art_recon_1595_003_request_timeout}" -OutputFile "#{art_recon_1595_003_output_file}"
Write-Host "Scan complete. Results saved to: #{art_recon_1595_003_output_file}"
